title: Preserve complete open work across CLI and chat in both directions
preconditions: each direction uses one stable session identity
the origin snapshot is a confirmed saved revision with an exact digest
open question, non-answer, conflict, and evidence-gap records are present before restart
reason, owner, blocked use, next action, refresh route, and handoff reference are explicit
the destination projection is produced only after a modeled process restart
no inferred answer or authority change is permitted

steps.action: create complete open-work state through CLI and confirm its saved snapshot
steps.expected_observation: after restart the chat projection has the same state identity and all durable business fields

steps.action: create complete open-work state through chat and confirm its saved snapshot
steps.expected_observation: after restart the CLI projection has the same state identity and all durable business fields

steps.action: compare each origin, persisted, and destination projection
steps.expected_observation: session, revision, digest, question, non-answer, conflict, evidence-gap, refresh, handoff, and authority fields are equal
missing metadata, identity drift, revision or digest drift, lost open work, and live execution are rejected for distinct reasons

assertions: both CLI-to-chat and chat-to-CLI directions are present
all snapshots carry complete comparison and durable business metadata
session identity, confirmed revision, and state digest are unchanged in each direction
current question, open questions, non-answers, conflicts, and evidence gaps are unchanged
reason, owner, blocked use, next action, refresh route, and handoff reference are unchanged
no answer is inferred from silence or restart
outcome_ceiling: A synthetic dry-run shape pass proves only that the evidence protocol discriminates the selected continuity failures in both directions. It is not a runtime observation or an obligation-satisfaction verdict.
